notes: Most items are pending-year (2014/2015 rejected by params?). tcsumm-2021-41 and tcsumm-2020-9 (2015) were also run with the year set to 2016 as a logic check: all items matched. tcsumm-2019-33 hand computation (HOH, one child, 2015 tables) reproduces the 10,518 deficiency exactly. The one mismatch (tcsumm-2020-18, 2016 penalty) is the court's own figure: 1,860.60 = 20% of 9,303, not of the 10,331 deficiency (2,066.20).

frameworkGaps.missing: Only 2016-2024 supported; blocks 17 items across 5 cases
frameworkGaps.fix: Add 2014 (Rev. Proc. 2013-35) and 2015 (Rev. Proc. 2014-61) parameters incl. tax tables, standard deduction (2015 HOH 9,250), EIC tables (2015 no-child phase-out end 14,820). In progress per ADDENDUM.

frameworkGaps.missing: No education credits; tcsumm-2019-24 (4-prior-year bar, sec. 25A(i)(2)) and tcsumm-2020-9 (2014 credit) not encodable
frameworkGaps.fix: Per-student record (prior AOTC years, half-time, first 4 years, qualified expenses); 100% of first 2,000 + 25% of next 2,000, 40% refundable; MAGI phase-out; expose educationCreditNonrefundable, aotcRefundable, aotcEligible:<student>.

frameworkGaps.missing: No input; non-qualified distribution and 20% additional tax entered as otherIncome/otherTaxes
frameworkGaps.fix: Add hsaDistributions, hsaQualifiedExpenses, exception flag (death/disability/65); include excess in income and add 20% as a checkable tax item.

frameworkGaps.missing: No winnings/losses fields or cap of losses at winnings
frameworkGaps.fix: Add gamblingWinnings, gamblingLosses; deduction = min(losses, winnings) as itemized.

frameworkGaps.missing: Only generic adjustments; no contribution limit, active-participant phase-out, or bar on pretax sec. 414(h) contributions
frameworkGaps.fix: Add iraContribution with sec. 219(b) limit and per-year phase-out.

frameworkGaps.missing: tieBreak assumes each rival claimant satisfies sec. 152(c)(1) and filed a valid return
frameworkGaps.fix: Optional qualifies: Bool (default true) on Claimant; filter before tie-break.
